system.session.title: Current session permissions
system.session.hint: From the confirmed current session. Display is not a security boundary; the backend authorizes each request.
system.session.unavailable: No confirmed signed-in session. Previous identity and grants are hidden.
system.session.fixedRoles: Only admin and view roles exist. This is read-only; accounts and role binding share identity management.
system.source.title: Rule configuration centers
system.source.subtitle: Register and update connections. Configuration centers remain authoritative for rules. Credentials are never returned and setup stays closed.
system.source.mockNotice: In demo mode, connection checks are simulated and do not contact Nacos or Consul. Live checks are performed by the Console backend.
system.source.name: Connection name
system.source.endpointHint: HTTP(S) address may include a service path. Do not embed credentials.
system.source.locationHint: Leave empty for the server default. Re-enter after changing provider.
system.source.keepHint: Keeping never reads or reveals existing passwords, tokens or reference values.
system.source.referenceHint: Resolved by the backend. Neither the reference nor its secret is returned.
system.source.secretHint: Submitted only for this operation; never persisted in the browser.
system.source.editHint: Saving a connection does not edit, publish or apply traffic rules.
system.source.checkHint: The test checks the current candidate only. It does not register, write rules or grant publishing rights. Any field change invalidates the result.
system.source.validationHint: Check the name, HTTP(S) endpoint and credentials required by the selected method.
system.source.checkPending: Checking current settings. Editing fields cancels this test.
system.source.checkFailed: Connection test could not be completed
system.source.checkFailedHint: No source or rule change was submitted. Review the current input and service state, then explicitly retry the connection test.
system.source.pending: Submitted; waiting for backend confirmation. Do not save again.
system.source.saved: Save confirmed; refreshing the registry. This is not a rule publication or instance receipt.
system.source.conflict: The configuration changed. Refresh and reopen the source before editing; newer revisions are not overwritten.
system.source.failed: Registration failed. Review settings before starting a new operation.
system.source.unknown: The save outcome is unknown. Credentials have been cleared. Inspect the original operation; do not resend.
system.source.inspectFailed: No confirmation obtained. Input or probe failures never permit a resend. Refresh facts or inspect the original operation.
system.observed.connectionsHint: Configuration, metrics and reporting are probed independently. Browser connectivity is not service health.
system.observed.expiredProbe: This probe had expired at read time. Run a new probe.
system.observed.protocolsHint: Backend-supported and negotiated versions are separate facts, not an implementation checklist.
system.observed.readIdle: System facts have not been requested.
system.observed.readRefreshing: Refreshing; the last successful read is shown.
system.observed.readFilteredEmpty: No records match these filters or page.
system.observed.readDenied: Read access denied. Previous content has been removed.
system.observed.readFailed: Read failed. Retry; failure is not an empty result.
system.observed.readStale: Read failed. Retained content is stale and not current state.
system.observed.readPartial: Some connections or versions are unconfirmed. Check each result.
system.audit.title: Operation audit
system.audit.hint: Administrators only. Independent UTC window; no passwords, rule bodies or request logs.
system.audit.invalidHint: Enter a valid increasing UTC range no longer than 31 days.
system.connection.note: Real Nacos / Consul health checks, conditional writes and rollback must be implemented by a separate management service.
system.connection.subtitle: Config-center read/write, metrics and event reporting are separate links; every status below is a sample.
system.connection.title: Connection and capability status
system.intro.description: Inspect the boundaries between config center, metric collection and event reporting, keeping operational permissions simple and explicit.
system.intro.title: System management
system.permissions.audit.step1.title: Edit and validate
system.permissions.audit.step2.title: Generate the diff
system.permissions.audit.step3.title: Conditional write-back
system.permissions.audit.step4.title: Observe effect
system.permissions.auditSubtitle: This prototype does not produce real release records.
system.permissions.grantHint: How to grant: create the account under “Account maintenance”, then assign it a role under “Role binding”. Hiding UI is not a security boundary; the server re-validates on every write.
system.permissions.maintainer.descriptio: Can submit rule changes; the production flow still requires baseline version checks and auditing.
system.permissions.maintainer.title: Rule maintainer
system.permissions.subtitle: Only distinguishes viewing from modifying rules; no multi-tenant RBAC.
system.permissions.title: Least-privilege model
system.permissions.viewer.description: Can view the overview, application instances, live metrics, incidents and rule details.
system.permissions.viewer.title: Viewer
system.protocol.agentReporting.name: Agent Reporting
system.protocol.agentReporting.role: Reports instance versions, health and events; takes no part in admission decisions.
system.protocol.boundarySubtitle: Control plane and observability plane evolve independently.
system.protocol.clusterToken.name: Cluster Token
system.protocol.clusterToken.role: Owns quota decisions, separate from rule editing and event reporting.
system.protocol.delivery.uiState.label: UI status
system.protocol.deliverySubtitle: Sample values do not reflect the deployment environment.
system.protocol.note: Before delivery, verify the UI, the management service, the config center and the instance-effect loop separately.
system.protocol.ruleConfig.name: Rule configuration
system.protocol.ruleConfig.role: Nacos / Consul is the authoritative rule source; the Dashboard writes through the management service.
